title: Add minimal Rust workspace (raptor-core, raptor-cli)
body:
## Summary

- Workspace root `Cargo.toml` with resolver 2, edition 2024, rust-version 1.85
- `rust-toolchain.toml` pins toolchain to 1.95.0 for local + CI reproducibility
- `raptor-core` — library crate with `RaptorError` skeleton
- `raptor-cli` — binary crate producing `raptor` executable (clap 4)
- `Cargo.lock` committed for reproducible builds

## Test plan

- [ ] CI passes: fmt, clippy -D warnings, test (ubuntu/macos/windows)
- [ ] `cargo run --bin raptor -- --version` prints version
- [ ] `cargo run --bin raptor -- --help` prints usage
